Container.Name: jack-ui
Container.Overview: The web interface for jack, where you set jack up and add friends. It talks to the jack container over the "jack" Docker network. Keep it on your LAN: never add it to your reverse proxy.
Container.Requires: The jack container, on the same "jack" Docker network.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web interface. Pick another (e.g. 3010) if 3000 is taken.

Config.Name: Management key
Config.Description: The same value as Management key in the jack template. With it, jack-ui doesn't ask for a login, so keep its port on your LAN. To be asked for the key in the browser instead, leave this empty and set Session key under Show more settings.

Config.Name: Session key
Config.Description: Only when Management key is empty: a random secret of at least 32 characters (openssl rand -hex 32). jack-ui uses it to keep you signed in.

Config.Name: Management API
Config.Description: jack's management API on the jack network. It is not published on your server.
